verdict.rationale: Vercel Sandbox is a sandbox product. Its docs state that it runs agent-generated code in isolated Linux microVMs "without exposing your production systems", and they promote testing in a self-contained environment with logs, file edits, and live previews. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation, and documentation of how production data or credentials are kept out (e.g., network egress controls or test-data seeding).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Run AI agent output, user uploads, or third-party scripts without exposing your production systems.
Test in isolation: Preview how user-submitted or agent-generated code behaves in a self-contained environment with access to logs, file edits, and live previews.
Run untrusted or agent-generated code in isolated Linux microVMs.
